question: Find the mean proportional between (13 + 8√5) and (10 − 2√5).
solution:
× **Given:**

Find the mean proportional between (13 + 8√5) and (10 − 2√5)

**Formula used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculations:**

a = 13 + 8√5

b = 10 − 2√5

⇒ Mean proportional = √[(13 + 8√5)(10 − 2√5)]

Use identity: (a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd

⇒ (13 × 10) + (13 × -2√5) + (8√5 × 10) + (8√5 × -2√5)

⇒ 130 − 26√5 + 80√5 − 16 × 5

⇒ 130 − 26√5 + 80√5 − 80

⇒ (130 − 80) + (80√5 − 26√5) = 50 + 54√5

⇒ Mean proportional = √(50 + 54√5)

**∴ The mean proportional is √(50 + 54√5)**
